assertions.assertion: Output contains a call to builder.Services.AddIdentityServer with an options lambda
assertions.rationale: Calls builder.Services.AddIdentityServer(options => { ... }) with a lambda configuring events.

assertions.assertion: Output enables all four event types: RaiseErrorEvents, RaiseInformationEvents, RaiseFailureEvents, RaiseSuccessEvents all set to true
assertions.rationale: All four event flags are explicitly set to true in the options lambda.

assertions.assertion: Output calls AddInMemoryIdentityResources with at least IdentityResources.OpenId() and IdentityResources.Profile()
assertions.rationale: Config.IdentityResources contains new IdentityResources.OpenId() and new IdentityResources.Profile(), registered via AddInMemoryIdentityResources.

assertions.assertion: Output calls AddInMemoryApiScopes with a scope named 'weatherapi'
assertions.rationale: AddInMemoryApiScopes registers Config.ApiScopes which defines new ApiScope("weatherapi", ...).

assertions.assertion: Output calls app.UseIdentityServer() and does NOT separately call app.UseAuthentication()
assertions.rationale: app.UseIdentityServer() is called and there is no separate app.UseAuthentication() call; a note explains why.
